==Details==
{{Quest details page|Mourning's End Part II}}

==Walkthrough==
===Entering the temple===
{{Needed|Full [[mourner gear]], [[chisel]].|recommended=[[teleport crystal|Elf teleport crystal]], teleport to [[Ardougne]], [[food]] and [[armour]]/[[prayer potions]] to run past high level monsters, 3 free inventory spaces}}
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - Blackened crystal.png|275px|right|thumb|Map of the area and path to the blackened crystal.]]
{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Arianwyn]] in [[Lletya]].
*(optional) '''Note to Ironmen: ''' if you do not have a death talisman, search the bookshelves for a book titled [[Prifddinas' history]]. You might need it later as part of the 50 items and this will allow you to potentially save time and a charge on your teleport.
*Wearing your mourner gear, talk to [[Essyllt]] under the hideout in [[West Ardougne]] (north-east corner of town). He gives you the [[new key]].
*Run west through the cave, keep going until you find the dead bodies. There will be a cutscene.
*Search a guard corpse for [[Edern's journal]].
*Follow the red line in the map to get to the black crystal.
*Use your chisel to chip off a piece.
*Return and talk to [[Arianwyn]] in [[Lletya]] to enchant your crystal.
}}

===The light puzzles===
{{Needed|Full [[mourner gear]], the [[new key]], [[rope]]. If you're planning to complete the puzzles in a single trip, bring a [[death talisman]]/[[death tiara]]/[[catalytic talisman]] and the [[newly made crystal]] too. A [[death talisman]] can be obtained from [[dark beast]]s. Ironmen without a death talisman will have to bring a list of 50 items instead after completing the puzzles.|recommended=[[Weight-reducing clothing]], high [[Prayer items|prayer bonus]] gear, [[prayer potion]]s, [[stamina potion]]s, [[food]], [[summer pie]]s/[[agility potion]]s, [[pure essence]] (for the [[hard Ardougne Diary]] task), 5 empty inventory spaces.}}

====Chest #1====
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - chest 1 solution.png|275px|right|thumb|Chest #1 solution.]]
{{Checklist|
*Go back to the [[Temple of Light]].
*Take the eastern set stairs, that are directly in front of the entrance, to the middle floor.
*Head to the area indicated by the rope on the guide map and use your rope on the rocks.
*Drop your [[new key]].
*Head to the area marked with mirror #1 just east of the stairs.
*''Pull'' the crystal dispenser on the wall to reset the puzzle and then ''collect'' all of the items which includes mirrors and a {{plink|Yellow crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Yellow crystal}}.{{Chat option|1Pull the lever.|1Pull it.|3Take all the items.}}
*Place {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #1 to shine the light north.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #2 points west.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #3 points south.
*Place the {{plink|Yellow crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Yellow crystal}}. The light will turn yellow.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #4 points east.
*Cross the gap to the other side. Use any agility boosts you have. You will have to cross this gap a second time later.
*Open the chest to obtain 2 mirrors and a {{plink|Cyan crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Cyan crystal}}.
}}{{clear}}

====Chest #2====
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - chest 2 solution.png|275px|right|thumb|Chest #2 solution.]]
{{Checklist|
*Reset the puzzle at the crystal dispenser and ''collect'' all items.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #1 points north.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #2 points west.
*Place the {{plink|Cyan crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Cyan crystal}}. The light will turn cyan.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #3 points north.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #4 points east.
*Place the {{plink|Yellow crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Yellow crystal}}. The light will turn green.
*Open the chest to obtain 2 mirrors.
*Do NOT reset the puzzle.
}}{{clear}}

====Chest #3====
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - chest 3 solution.png|275px|right|thumb|Chest #3 solution.]]
{{Checklist|
*Pick up the {{plink|Yellow crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Yellow crystal}} and replace it with {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #5 pointing up to the top floor. Long side of the mirror should be pointing east.
*Climb the north ladder to the top floor.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #6 points west. The light to the west turns blue.
*Go back to the middle floor and take the south stairs up to the top floor.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #7 points down toward the middle floor. Long side of the mirror should be pointing east.
*Climb to the bottom floor.
*Head to {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #8, going through the eastern yellow barrier. Turn {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #8 to point south.
*Go through the southern barrier and follow the path. Open the chest to obtain 2 mirrors and a {{plink|Fractured crystal (horizontal)|txt=Fractured crystal}}.
*Go back through the southern barrier and rotate the mirror to point east.
*Exit through the eastern barrier.
*Do NOT reset the puzzle.
}}{{clear}}

====Chest #4====
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - chest 4 solution.png|275px|right|thumb|Chest #4 solution.]]
{{Checklist|
*Take the east stairs to the middle floor.
*Take out the {{plink|Cyan crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Cyan crystal}} and place the {{plink|Yellow crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Yellow crystal}} instead. The light will now be yellow.
*Climb up the south ladder to the top floor.
*Rotate {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #7 to shine the light south. This light should be red. Run south to mirror 8.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #8 point down toward the middle floor. Long side of the mirror should be pointing north.
*Climb down the south ladder to the middle floor.
*Use the rope shortcut to reach the bottom floor.
*Head to {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #9 and open the chest to obtain a {{plink|Blue crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Blue crystal}}.
}}{{clear}}

====Chest #5====
=====Part 1=====
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - chest 5 solution - part 1.png|275px|right|thumb|Chest #5, part 1.]]
{{Checklist|
*Reset the puzzle
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #1 points north.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #2 points west.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #3 points south.
*Place the {{plink|Yellow crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Yellow crystal}}. The light will turn yellow.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #4 points east.
*Cross the gap to the other side.
*Place the {{plink|Blue crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Blue crystal}}.
*Remove {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #4.
*Rotate {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #3 points up.
*Use the south stairs to head to the top floor.}}{{clear}}

=====Part 2=====
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - chest 5 solution - part 2.png|275px|right|thumb|Chest #5, part 2.]]
{{Checklist|
*Place {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #4 in the new position pointing south.
*Place the {{plink|Fractured crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Fractured crystal|pic=Fractured crystal (horizontal)}}.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #5 makes the western light point down. Long side of the mirror should be pointing east.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #6 makes the southern light point east.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #7 points down. Long side of the mirror should be pointing west.
*Go to the bottom floor.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #8 points south.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #9 points east.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #10 points north.
*Open the chest to obtain 3 mirrors and a second {{plink|Fractured crystal (horizontal)|txt=Fractured crystal}}.
}}{{clear}}

====Death Altar Puzzle====
[[File:Mourning's End Part II - Death Altar solution.png|275px|right|thumb|Death Altar solution.]]
{{Checklist|
*Reset the puzzle.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #1 points north.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #2 points down. Long side of the mirror should be pointing south.
*Use the east stairs to go down to the bottom floor.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #3 points west.
*Place the {{plink|Fractured crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Fractured crystal|pic=Fractured crystal (vertical)}}.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #4 points the northern light up.
*Place the {{plink|Fractured crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Fractured crystal|pic=Fractured crystal (horizontal)}}.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #5 points the western light up.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #6 points the eastern light up.
*Climb the east stairs to the middle floor.
*Place the {{plink|Yellow crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Yellow crystal}}. The light will turn yellow.
*Climb up the north ladder to the top floor.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #7 points west. You should see the light turn red at the pillar to the west.
*Climb down the north ladder to the middle floor.
*Climb up the south ladder to the top floor.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #8 points west.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #9 points west.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #10 points north.
*Cross to the north part of the top floor via the middle stairs.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #11 points west.
*Place the {{plink|Blue crystal (Mourning's End Part II)|txt=Blue crystal}}. The light will turn blue.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #12 points south.
*{{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #13 points east.
*Go down the middle stairs twice to the inner part of the ground floor.
*Rotate {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #14 so it points west.
*Go through to the Death Altar.
*'''When you're ready to leave, make sure to turn {{plinkp|Hand mirror}} Mirror #14 back towards the entrance door, otherwise to get back in here you will need to go through the Underground Pass.'''
}}

===Finishing up===
{{Checklist|
*If you do not have a [[death talisman]]/[[death tiara|tiara]] or [[catalytic talisman]]/[[catalytic tiara|tiara]], refer to the [[Mourning's End Part II#The Death Altar|full guide]] to get the 50 required items.
**Returning to [[Thorgel]]: go up the eastern stairs, then south and up the ladder to the top floor to return to Thorgel. Climb the stairs down to the altar twice.
*Make sure to bring your newly made crystal you obtained at the start of the quest.
*Enter the [[Death Altar]].
*Use the uncharged [[newly made crystal]] on the altar.
*Use the charged [[newly made crystal]] on the black crystal on the top floor.
*Travel to [[Lletya]].
*Talk to [[Arianwyn]].
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
